objective: Test whether equality of the bounded direct local normal form is a literal-action transition congruence: equal normalized parents must map under each literal move to one identical normalized child/terminal token.
distinction: This tests existence of an abstract exact F_G on Q_DIRECT_LOCAL_NORMAL. It is stronger and different from testing the inherited q_o cofactor formula.
tests: same normalized parent implies same legal literal actions
same normalized parent + same literal action implies same terminal token or identical normalized child
if normalized child differs, check whether child complete-future class nevertheless agrees
falsification_rule: Any normalized-parent/action fiber with more than one normalized child/terminal result falsifies exact self-update F_G(Q,m,G)=Q' for this representation.
construction_firewall: Complete future classes are used only to classify any congruence failure after it is found.
